title: Verify: Spritesheet frame and animation validation unit tests
description: Test parseManifest on in-memory sheets and on the committed manifest.
technical_constraints: Pure in-memory plus read of manifest.json

steps.action: Import parseManifest from ../src/assets/manifest. Case 1: sheet 64x48 frames 32/48/3 → ok false with an error path 'assets.0.frames.frameCount'. Case 2: sheet 64x48 frames 32/48/2 with animation idle frames [0,5] → error path 'assets.0.animations.idle.frames'. Case 3: frameHeight 60 on height 48 → error path containing 'frameHeight'. Case 4: JSON.parse of public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json → ok true.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sg3SheetValidation.test.ts
